# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

## Surface the GOLD final DB state (or gold action args) in the trajectory bundle
- Several clusters (task 12's "leave everything unchanged" vs gold-still-writes-bags; task 23's exact 3-booking + cancel shape) could not be resolved confidently because the trajectories only show the AGENT's actions + a diff-style "DB does not match" message, never the gold end-state. The action-trace "gold performs this Nx" hints help but are diagnostic-only and incomplete. A per-task `gold_db_delta` (or the gold action list with args) in `./trajectories/` would let the optimizer write a correct general rule instead of inferring from near-miss pass/fail pairs. This is the single biggest missing signal.

## The tau2 runtime is not importable in the working dir (missing deps, e.g. loguru)
- Code edits to `tools.py` cannot be executed against the real FlightDB here (import fails on `loguru`), so guards can only be unit-logic-tested in isolation. A minimal importable stub of the tau2 data models + a tiny fixture DB in the working dir would let optimizers actually RUN a new guard on the failing trace's args, as the CHECK step asks for, instead of reading it through.
